items_flat.title_en: Amodei: pace the frontier; Anthropic commits to embedded evaluators
items_flat.title_zh: Amodei：放緩前沿；Anthropic 承諾嵌入第三方評估
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published the essay “We Must Pace the Frontier,” arguing labs should slow capability gains so alignment and operational safety can keep up. Anthropic unilaterally committed to give third-party evaluators (e.g. METR) permanent, employee-level access to systems, incidents, and training pipelines, while calling for democratic and then global coordination on standards.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 發表〈We Must Pace the Frontier〉，主張實驗室應放緩能力推進，讓對齊與營運安全跟上。Anthropic 單方面承諾給予第三方評估者（如 METR）常駐、等同員工的系統、事故與訓練管線權限，並呼籲民主國家再擴及全球協調標準。
items_flat.analysis_en: The concrete change is verifiability, not a freeze: Anthropic is opening training pipelines to outsiders in a way no frontier lab has normalized. Whether “pacing” becomes industry practice still depends on matching operational access from peers and any government requirement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 真正改變的是可驗證性而非停訓：Anthropic 把訓練管線對外部開放，這尚未成為前沿實驗室常態。放緩能否成業內慣例，仍取決於同業是否給出同等營運權限，以及政府是否強制。
items_flat.quote: We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們必須放緩提升 AI 模型能力的速度。進展看起來仍會很快，我們必須善用爭取到的時間。

links.label: Dario Amodei — We Must Pace the Frontier

items_flat.title_en: Altman: OpenAI will also give independent evaluators employee-like access
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：OpenAI 也將給予獨立評估者等同員工的權限
items_flat.summary_en: Responding to Amodei’s post, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman wrote that he agrees the industry needs to pace the frontier and that this has been a primary internal discussion in recent weeks. He called independent evaluators with employee-like access a great idea and said OpenAI will do the same, with more detail to follow.
items_flat.summary_zh: 回應 Amodei 貼文，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 寫道他同意產業需要放緩前沿，且這是該公司近幾週的主要內部討論。他稱具員工級權限的獨立評估是好主意，OpenAI 也會照做，細節稍後公布。
items_flat.analysis_en: An in-kind match from OpenAI turns Anthropic’s unilateral step into a two-lab norm—if the forthcoming details actually include training-time access rather than post-hoc audits. Scope, evaluator identity, and publication rights remain unspecified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI 對等跟進，使 Anthropic 的單邊承諾有機會變成兩家實驗室的新常態——前提是後續細節包含訓練期權限，而非事後稽核。評估者身分、範圍與公開權仍未說明。
items_flat.quote: Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same. We'll have more to share soon.
items_flat.quote_zh: 承諾讓獨立評估者擁有等同員工的權限是好主意，我們也會這樣做。細節稍後公布。

items_flat.title_en: Altman: an OpenAI IPO in 2026 would be ill-advised
items_flat.title_zh: Altman：OpenAI 2026 年 IPO 並不適宜
items_flat.summary_en: In a Fortune interview published Saturday, Sam Altman said that given current safety work, now would be an ill-advised moment to go public and that OpenAI would not list in 2026. He said the company does not feel IPO pressure and wants to handle safety, alignment, and government coordination as a private firm.
items_flat.summary_zh: 週六刊出的《Fortune》訪談中，Sam Altman 表示以目前安全工作來看，現在公開上市並不適宜，OpenAI 不會在 2026 年掛牌。他說公司沒有 IPO 壓力，希望以私人公司身分處理安全、對齊與政府協調。
items_flat.analysis_en: The statement recasts listing timing as a safety-governance choice rather than a market-window choice. It does not cancel a later IPO and does not by itself change training cadence or evaluator access.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此話把上市時點重新框成安全治理選擇，而非單純市場窗口。它並未取消較晚的 IPO，本身也不改變訓練節奏或評估者權限。
items_flat.quote: I actually think that given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public.
items_flat.quote_zh: 考量目前與安全相關的一切，我認為現在公開上市並不適宜。

items_flat.title_en: Musk: “Dario is right” on pacing; later backs competitor peer review
items_flat.title_zh: Musk：放緩議題上「Dario 是對的」；其後支持同業互評
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk quoted Amodei’s pacing essay and wrote “Dario is right.” Early on 13 Sep UTC he added that there should be some oversight and that “peer review of AI by competitors is the right way to start.” Later he amplified a clip arguing for informal competitor early access of a week or two before release.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 轉貼 Amodei 放緩長文並寫「Dario 是對的」。9 月 13 日 UTC 稍早他補充應有某種監督，且「由競爭對手做 AI 同業互評是起步的正確方式」。其後他再轉發主張發布前給同業一至兩週非正式搶先權限的說法。
items_flat.analysis_en: A public agreement from xAI’s principal is notable because the lab has competed on release cadence. An endorsement plus “competitor peer review” is still not operational access comparable to Anthropic’s embedded-evaluator pledge.
items_flat.analysis_zh: xAI 主導者公開同意值得注意，因為該實驗室一向以發布節奏競爭。贊同加上「同業互評」，仍不等同 Anthropic 那種嵌入式評估的營運權限承諾。
items_flat.quote: Dario is right that there should be some oversight. Peer review of AI by competitors is the right way to start this off.
items_flat.quote_zh: Dario 說得對，應該要有某種監督。由競爭對手做 AI 同業互評，是起步的正確方式。

items_flat.title_en: Grok models begin rolling out in Microsoft Copilot Office apps
items_flat.title_zh: Grok 模型開始導入微軟 Copilot 辦公應用
items_flat.summary_en: Microsoft 365 said Grok models from SpaceXAI are rolling out in Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, starting with a focused release to Microsoft Frontier program customers. CEO Satya Nadella added “More model choice coming to Copilot. Welcome Grok!”
items_flat.summary_zh: Microsoft 365 表示 SpaceXAI 的 Grok 模型正導入 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 的 Copilot，先以 Microsoft Frontier 計畫客戶為焦點釋出。執行長 Satya Nadella 補充：「Copilot 將有更多模型選擇。歡迎 Grok！」
items_flat.analysis_en: Copilot already hosts OpenAI and Anthropic models; adding Grok makes Microsoft the widest enterprise front door among frontier labs. Which Grok checkpoint ships, how tenant data is handled, and whether the drop is default or opt-in remain unspecified in the launch posts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Copilot 已托管 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 模型；加入 Grok 使微軟成為涵蓋最多前沿實驗室的企業入口。發布貼文未說明實際搭載哪個 Grok 檢查點、租戶資料如何處理，以及預設開啟或需選擇加入。
items_flat.quote: Grok models from SpaceXAI are rolling out in Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint—starting with a focused release to customers in the Microsoft Frontier program.
items_flat.quote_zh: SpaceXAI 的 Grok 模型正導入 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 的 Copilot——先以 Microsoft Frontier 計畫客戶為焦點釋出。
